messages:
maria: Heads up — staging keystore cutover tonight 22:00 PT. Need evidence capture for KMS key rotation, HSM attestation logs, and auditlog backfill for nonprod. Who can own auditlog backfill + proof artifacts? cc @crypto-oncall

jonathan: I can take auditlog backfill. ETA tomorrow EOD. Need runbook + sample query.

maria: thanks. runbook: https://internal.runbooks/redwood/keystore-cutover — see 'evidence' section. Also need someone to validate HSM attestation output (signed manifest).

samir: I can validate attestation. Where will the manifest be uploaded? S3 path?

maria: upload to s3://redwood-audit/staging/keystore-attest/<cutover_ts> — use file name `attest-manifest.json`. Make sure the manifest includes `alias`, `key_uuid`, `signature`, and `timestamp`.

olivia: Quick question: does Dedicated stage need a different key id? I think it's the same alias but different key material. Need clarity for proof.

kevin: Dedicated uses alias `redwood/staging` but separate key_uuid. For evidence, include both alias + key_uuid in manifest so auditors can map.

sec-bot: Reminder: control evidence template v2 required. Artifacts uploaded to the S3 path will be scanned for required fields. Runbook snippet:
```bash
# verify upload
aws s3 ls s3://redwood-audit/staging/keystore-attest/

# example query for audit logs (run in analytics):
SELECT * FROM audit_logs WHERE resource = 'kms' AND action IN ('CreateKey','RotateKey','Sign') AND timestamp >= '2026-03-18T22:00:00Z';
```

maria: action items:
- jonathan: auditlog backfill (owner)
- samir: attestation validation (owner)
- olivia: confirm dedicated alias proof and update runbook
- kevin: provide key_uuid mapping to artifacts
Please drop links to artifacts here. If anything slips, we'll escalate to oncall.

jonathan: will open backfill PR in #eng-releases and link the ingest job. ETA EOD tomorrow. I'll add sample query + checksum proof.

samir: validated attestation schema against HSM output locally. Will upload manifest to the S3 path and paste link in ~30m.

olivia: confirmed — adding note to Dedicated runbook about alias vs uuid mapping. :thumbsup:

kevin: uploaded `key_map_staging.csv` to s3://redwood-configs/keystore-maps/key_map_staging.csv. DM me if you need the KMS UUIDs decrypted for any reports.

maria: thanks all. last ask — anyone available to be secondary evidence reviewer after 23:00 PT? need someone in overlap window.

olivia: I can be secondary until 00:30 PT.

jonathan: I can cover 00:30–02:00 PT.

sec-bot: Deploy scheduled at 2026-03-18T22:00:00Z and runbook acked by owners: jonathan, samir, olivia, kevin.

maria: closing thread — please update PRs with artifact links and fill the evidence checklist item: `evidence/2026-03-18-staging-keystore`. I'll mark owners and next steps. :raised_hands:
